```{r Create output directory structure}
# ============================================================================
# MASTER OUTPUT DIRECTORY STRUCTURE
# ============================================================================

output_dir  <- "DEG_results"

# Sub-folders
qc_dir                  <- file.path(output_dir, "QC")
contrasts_dir           <- file.path(output_dir, "Contrasts")
clusters_dir            <- file.path(output_dir, "Clusters")
loops_dir               <- file.path(output_dir, "Loops")
comp_dir                <- file.path(output_dir, "Compartments")
comp_enrichr_dir        <- file.path(comp_dir, "enrichr_compartments")

# Motif sub-folders (created here; homer paths defined later)
homer_promoter_dir      <- file.path(clusters_dir, "homer_promoter_motifs")
homer_chip_dir          <- file.path(clusters_dir, "homer_chip_motifs")

# Gene-list sub-folders
contrasts_genelists_dir <- file.path(contrasts_dir, "enrichment_gene_lists")
clusters_genelists_dir  <- file.path(clusters_dir,  "enrichment_gene_lists")

for (d in c(qc_dir, contrasts_dir, clusters_dir, loops_dir, comp_dir,
            comp_enrichr_dir, homer_promoter_dir, homer_chip_dir,
            contrasts_genelists_dir, clusters_genelists_dir)) {
  if (!dir.exists(d)) dir.create(d, recursive = TRUE)
}
```

```{r Pre-DESeq2 PCA - All samples including dec25 GFP}

# ── Paths ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
star_dec25 <- "R:/R_STIK/rna_seq/rnaseq_marta_REHAro_dec25/STAR"
star_mar26 <- "R:/R_STIK/rna_seq/rnaseq_marta_REHArg_mar26/STAR"

# ── Helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
read_star_counts <- function(file) {
  df     <- read.table(file, skip = 4, header = FALSE)
  counts <- df[, 2]
  names(counts) <- gsub("\\..*", "", df$V1)
  return(counts)
}

load_star_dir <- function(dir_path, exclude_pattern = NULL) {
  files <- list.files(dir_path, pattern = "ReadsPerGene.out.tab$", full.names = TRUE)
  if (!is.null(exclude_pattern))
    files <- files[!grepl(exclude_pattern, basename(files))]
  sample_names <- gsub("^STAR_(.*)ReadsPerGene\\.out\\.tab$", "\\1", basename(files))
  counts_list  <- lapply(files, read_star_counts)
  names(counts_list) <- sample_names
  return(counts_list)
}

# ── Load all samples from both runs ─────────────────────────────────────────
counts_dec25_full <- load_star_dir(star_dec25)   # includes dec25 GFP
counts_mar26_full <- load_star_dir(star_mar26)   # includes mar26 GFP

# Disambiguate GFP names before merging
gfp_pattern <- "^RNA-REH-GFP-"
names(counts_dec25_full) <- ifelse(
  grepl(gfp_pattern, names(counts_dec25_full)),
  paste0(names(counts_dec25_full), "_dec25"),
  names(counts_dec25_full)
)
names(counts_mar26_full) <- ifelse(
  grepl(gfp_pattern, names(counts_mar26_full)),
  paste0(names(counts_mar26_full), "_mar26"),
  names(counts_mar26_full)
)

all_counts_full   <- c(counts_dec25_full, counts_mar26_full)
counts_mat_full   <- do.call(cbind, all_counts_full)
sample_names_full <- colnames(counts_mat_full)

cat("Samples loaded from dec25:", length(counts_dec25_full), "\n")
cat("Samples loaded from mar26:", length(counts_mar26_full), "\n")
cat("Total samples in matrix  :", ncol(counts_mat_full), "\n")
cat("Sample names:\n"); cat(paste0("  ", sample_names_full, "\n"))

# ── Gene symbol annotation + deduplication ──────────────────────────────────
symbols_full <- mapIds(
  org.Hs.eg.db,
  keys      = rownames(counts_mat_full),
  column    = "SYMBOL",
  keytype   = "ENSEMBL",
  multiVals = "first"
)

valid_syms            <- !is.na(symbols_full)
counts_full_sym       <- counts_mat_full[valid_syms, ]
rownames(counts_full_sym) <- symbols_full[valid_syms]

counts_full_sym           <- as.data.frame(counts_full_sym)
counts_full_sym$symbol    <- rownames(counts_full_sym)
rownames(counts_full_sym) <- NULL
counts_full_sym$mean_expr <- rowMeans(counts_full_sym[, sample_names_full])

counts_full_sym <- counts_full_sym %>%
  group_by(symbol) %>%
  slice_max(mean_expr, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

counts_full_sym$mean_expr <- NULL
counts_full_sym            <- as.data.frame(counts_full_sym)
rownames(counts_full_sym)  <- counts_full_sym$symbol
counts_full_sym$symbol     <- NULL

coldata_full <- data.frame(
  row.names = colnames(counts_full_sym),

  condition = c(
    rep("REH",  3),
    rep("Aro",  3),
    rep("EP1",  3),
    rep("GFP",  3),
    rep("Arg",  3),
    rep("d189", 3),
    rep("d89",  3),
    rep("GFP",  3)
  ),

  batch = c(
    rep("batch1", 3),
    "batch1", "batch1", "batch2",
    "batch1", "batch1", "batch2",
    rep("batch1", 3),
    rep("batch3", 3),
    rep("batch3", 3),
    rep("batch3", 3),
    rep("batch3", 3)
  ),

  highlight = c(
    rep("REH",       3),
    rep("other",     6),   # fixed
    rep("GFP_dec25", 3),
    rep("other",     9),
    rep("GFP_mar26", 3)
  )
)

stopifnot(identical(rownames(coldata_full), colnames(counts_full_sym)))

# ── VST (blind, intercept-only — purely exploratory) ────────────────────────
dds_explore <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = counts_full_sym,
  colData   = coldata_full,
  design    = ~ 1
)
dds_explore <- dds_explore[rowSums(counts(dds_explore)) > 5, ]
vsd_explore  <- vst(dds_explore, blind = TRUE)

# ── PCA ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
pca_data   <- plotPCA(vsd_explore, intgroup = c("condition", "batch"), returnData = TRUE)
percentVar <- round(100 * attr(pca_data, "percentVar"))

# Attach highlight column for Plot 2
pca_data$highlight <- coldata_full[rownames(pca_data), "highlight"]

# Plot 1 — all 24 samples, condition + batch
p_all <- ggplot(pca_data, aes(PC1, PC2, color = condition, shape = batch, label = name)) +
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  geom_text_repel(size = 3, max.overlaps = 40) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(batch1 = 16, batch2 = 17, batch3 = 15)) +
  theme_bw() +
  xlab(paste0("PC1 (", percentVar[1], "% variance)")) +
  ylab(paste0("PC2 (", percentVar[2], "% variance)")) +
  ggtitle("PCA – All 24 samples (VST blind)\nColour = condition | Shape = batch")
print(p_all)
ggsave(file.path(qc_dir, "PCA_all24_condition_batch.pdf"), p_all, width = 10, height = 7)

# Plot 2 — GFP (dec25 vs mar26) and REH highlighted
p_highlight <- ggplot(pca_data, aes(PC1, PC2, label = name)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = condition, shape = batch), size = 4, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_point(
    data = pca_data[pca_data$highlight != "other", ],
    aes(fill = highlight),
    shape = 21, size = 5, color = "black", stroke = 1.2
  ) +
  geom_text_repel(size = 3, max.overlaps = 40) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(batch1 = 16, batch2 = 17, batch3 = 15)) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(GFP_dec25 = "#FFD700", GFP_mar26 = "#1f78b4", REH = "#33a02c"),
    name   = "Highlighted group",
    labels = c(GFP_dec25 = "GFP batch1/dec25",
               GFP_mar26 = "GFP batch3/mar26",
               REH       = "REH batch1 (control)")
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  xlab(paste0("PC1 (", percentVar[1], "% variance)")) +
  ylab(paste0("PC2 (", percentVar[2], "% variance)")) +
  ggtitle("PCA – GFP and REH highlighted\ngold = GFP dec25 | blue = GFP mar26 | green = REH")
print(p_highlight)
ggsave(file.path(qc_dir, "PCA_all24_GFP_REH_highlight.pdf"), p_highlight, width = 10, height = 7)

cat("Pre-DESeq2 PCA saved to", qc_dir, "\n")
```

```{r STAR counts}
# ============================================================================
# STAR COUNTS - merged from two sequencing runs
# dec25 folder : all samples EXCEPT STAR_RNA-REH-GFP*
# mar26 folder : STAR_RNA-REH-GFP*  +  every other sample in that folder
# ============================================================================

# star_dec25 <- "/ijc/LABS/STIK/RAW/rna_seq/rnaseq_marta_REHAro_dec25/STAR"
# star_mar26 <- "/ijc/LABS/STIK/RAW/rna_seq/rnaseq_marta_REHArg_mar26/STAR"

star_dec25 <- "R:/R_STIK/rna_seq/rnaseq_marta_REHAro_dec25/STAR"
star_mar26 <- "R:/R_STIK/rna_seq/rnaseq_marta_REHArg_mar26/STAR"

# --- helper: read a single STAR ReadsPerGene file --------------------------
read_star_counts <- function(file) {
  df     <- read.table(file, skip = 4, header = FALSE)
  counts <- df[, 2]
  names(counts) <- gsub("\\..*", "", df$V1)   # strip Ensembl version suffix
  return(counts)
}

# --- load samples -----------------------------------------------------------
# dec25: exclude GFP samples (they come from mar26 instead)
counts_dec25 <- load_star_dir(star_dec25, exclude_pattern = "GFP")

# mar26: all samples present (includes the GFP samples)
counts_mar26 <- load_star_dir(star_mar26)

# --- merge into one matrix --------------------------------------------------
# Combine both lists; mar26 entries will overwrite if names clash (they won't
# here because dec25 already has GFP excluded, but this is safe practice)
all_counts <- c(counts_dec25, counts_mar26)
# all_counts <- counts_mar26

counts_mat  <- do.call(cbind, all_counts)
sample_names <- colnames(counts_mat)

# cat("Samples loaded from dec25 :", length(counts_dec25), "\n")
cat("Samples loaded from mar26 :", length(counts_mar26), "\n")
cat("Total samples in matrix   :", ncol(counts_mat),     "\n")
cat("Sample names:\n"); cat(paste0("  ", sample_names, "\n"))
```

```{r gene symbol annotation}
# Map Ensembl IDs to gene symbols
ensembl_ids <- rownames(counts_mat)
symbols <- mapIds(
  org.Hs.eg.db,
  keys    = ensembl_ids,
  column  = "SYMBOL",
  keytype = "ENSEMBL",
  multiVals = "first"
)

# Keep only genes with valid gene symbols (remove NAs)
valid_symbols <- !is.na(symbols)
cat(paste("Total genes:", length(symbols), "\n"))
cat(paste("Genes with valid symbols:", sum(valid_symbols), "\n"))
cat(paste("Genes removed (no symbol):", sum(!valid_symbols), "\n\n"))

# Filter counts matrix to keep only genes with valid symbols
counts_sym <- counts_mat[valid_symbols, ]
rownames(counts_sym) <- symbols[valid_symbols]

# Convert to dataframe for deduplication
counts_sym        <- as.data.frame(counts_sym)
counts_sym$symbol <- rownames(counts_sym)
rownames(counts_sym) <- NULL

# Calculate mean expression across the 21 samples and deduplicate
# (keeping the row with highest mean expression per gene symbol)
counts_sym$mean_expr <- rowMeans(counts_sym[, sample_names])   # explicit column selection
counts_sym <- counts_sym %>%
  group_by(symbol) %>%
  slice_max(mean_expr, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()
cat(paste("Final unique genes after deduplication:", nrow(counts_sym), "\n"))

# Clean up and restore rownames
counts_sym$mean_expr <- NULL
counts_sym           <- as.data.frame(counts_sym)
rownames(counts_sym) <- counts_sym$symbol
counts_sym$symbol    <- NULL

# Confirm column order is preserved
stopifnot(identical(colnames(counts_sym), sample_names))
```

```{r DESeq2 Object}
# ============================================================================
# SAMPLE ORDER (21 samples, as returned by the STAR counts chunk)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
#  1  RNA-REH-1                  |  REH      | batch1
#  2  RNA-REH-2                  |  REH      | batch1
#  3  RNA-REH-3                  |  REH      | batch1
#  4  RNA-REH-EP1-AroLITE-GFP-1  |  Aro      | batch1
#  5  RNA-REH-EP1-AroLITE-GFP-2  |  Aro      | batch1
#  6  RNA-REH-EP1-AroLITE-GFP-3  |  Aro      | batch2
#  7  RNA-REH-EP1-GFP-1          |  EP1      | batch1
#  8  RNA-REH-EP1-GFP-2          |  EP1      | batch1
#  9  RNA-REH-EP1-GFP-3          |  EP1      | batch2
# 10  RNA-REH-EP1-Arg-1          |  Arg      | batch3
# 11  RNA-REH-EP1-Arg-2          |  Arg      | batch3
# 12  RNA-REH-EP1-Arg-3          |  Arg      | batch3
# 13  RNA-REH-EP1-d189-1         |  d189     | batch3
# 14  RNA-REH-EP1-d189-2         |  d189     | batch3
# 15  RNA-REH-EP1-d189-3         |  d189     | batch3
# 16  RNA-REH-EP1-d89-1          |  d89      | batch3
# 17  RNA-REH-EP1-d89-2          |  d89      | batch3
# 18  RNA-REH-EP1-d89-3          |  d89      | batch3
# 19  RNA-REH-GFP-1              |  GFP      | batch3
# 20  RNA-REH-GFP-2              |  GFP      | batch3
# 21  RNA-REH-GFP-3              |  GFP      | batch3
# ============================================================================

coldata<- data.frame(
  row.names = colnames(counts_sym),
  condition = c(
    rep("REH",  3),   # RNA-REH-1/2/3
    rep("Aro",  3),   # RNA-REH-EP1-AroLITE-GFP-1/2/3
    rep("EP1",  3),   # RNA-REH-EP1-GFP-1/2/3
    rep("Arg",  3),   # RNA-REH-EP1-Arg-1/2/3
    rep("d189", 3),   # RNA-REH-EP1-d189-1/2/3
    rep("d89",  3),   # RNA-REH-EP1-d89-1/2/3
    rep("GFP",  3)    # RNA-REH-GFP-1/2/3
  ),
  batch = c(
    rep("batch1", 3),              # REH-1/2/3
    "batch1", "batch1", "batch2",  # Aro-1/2 → batch1 ; Aro-3 → batch2
    "batch1", "batch1", "batch2",  # EP1-1/2 → batch1 ; EP1-3 → batch2
    rep("batch3", 9),              # Arg, d189, d89 (all mar26)
    rep("batch3", 3)               # GFP (mar26)
  )
)

# Sanity check: sample order must match counts_sym columns
stopifnot(identical(rownames(coldata), colnames(counts_sym)))

# Create DESeq2 object with ALL samples (including GFP)
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = counts_sym,
  colData   = coldata,
  design    = ~ condition
)
dds <- dds[rowSums(counts(dds)) > 5, ]
dds$condition <- relevel(dds$condition, ref = "REH")
# dds$condition <- relevel(dds$condition, ref = "GFP")

# Run DESeq2
dds <- DESeq(dds)
```

```{r Sequencing QC}
# Library size plot
libsize <- colSums(counts(dds))
df_lib <- data.frame(
  sample = names(libsize),
  reads = libsize,
  condition = coldata$condition
)

p_libsize <- ggplot(df_lib, aes(sample, reads, fill = condition)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  scale_y_log10() +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  ggtitle("Library size (log10)")
print(p_libsize)
ggsave(file.path(qc_dir, "library_size_batch3.pdf"), p_libsize, width = 10, height = 6)

# VST transformation
vsd_original <- vst(dds, blind=TRUE)

# Batch-corrected version for visualization
vsd_corrected <- vsd_original
mat <- assay(vsd_original)
mat_corrected <- removeBatchEffect(mat,
                                   batch=vsd_original$batch,
                                   design=model.matrix(~condition, colData(vsd_original)))
assay(vsd_corrected) <- mat_corrected
```

```{r Sample QC - PCA}
# PCA before batch correction
pca_original <- plotPCA(vsd_original, intgroup = c("condition", "batch"), returnData = TRUE)

percentVar <- round(100 * attr(pca_original, "percentVar"))

p_pca_before <- ggplot(pca_original, aes(PC1, PC2, color = condition, shape = batch, label = name)) +

print(p_pca_before)
ggsave(file.path(qc_dir, "PCA_before_batch_correction.pdf"), p_pca_before, width = 8, height = 6)

# PCA after batch correction
pca_corrected <- plotPCA(vsd_corrected, intgroup = c("condition", "batch"), returnData = TRUE)

percentVar_corrected <- round(100 * attr(pca_corrected, "percentVar"))

p_pca_after <- ggplot(pca_corrected, aes(PC1, PC2, color = condition, shape = batch, label = name)) +
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  geom_text_repel() +
  theme_bw() +
  xlab(paste0("PC1 (", percentVar_corrected[1], "% variance)")) +
  ylab(paste0("PC2 (", percentVar_corrected[2], "% variance)")) +
  ggtitle("PCA – After Batch Correction")
print(p_pca_after)
ggsave(file.path(qc_dir, "PCA_after_batch_correction.pdf"), p_pca_after, width = 8, height = 6)
```

```{r Heatmap}
# Top 500 variable genes
top_var <- head(order(rowVars(assay(vsd_original)), decreasing = TRUE), 500)

# Annotation
ann <- data.frame(
  condition = coldata$condition,
  batch = coldata$batch,
  row.names = colnames(counts_sym)
)

# Heatmap before batch correction
mat_original <- assay(vsd_original)[top_var, ]
mat_original <- mat_original - rowMeans(mat_original)

pdf(file.path(qc_dir, "heatmap_top500_before_batch_correction.pdf"), width = 10, height = 10)
pheatmap(
  mat_original,
  annotation_col = ann,
  show_rownames = FALSE,
  color = colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(9,"RdBu")))(255),
  fontsize_col = 10,
  main = "Heatmap - Before Batch Correction"
)
dev.off()
pheatmap(
  mat_original,
  annotation_col = ann,
  show_rownames = FALSE,
  color = colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(9,"RdBu")))(255),
  fontsize_col = 10,
  main = "Heatmap - Before Batch Correction"
)

# Heatmap after batch correction
mat_corrected <- assay(vsd_corrected)[top_var, ]
mat_corrected <- mat_corrected - rowMeans(mat_corrected)

pdf(file.path(qc_dir, "heatmap_top500_after_batch_correction.pdf"), width = 10, height = 10)
pheatmap(
  mat_corrected,
  annotation_col = ann,
  show_rownames = FALSE,
  color = colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(9,"RdBu")))(255),
  fontsize_col = 10,
  main = "Heatmap - After Batch Correction"
)
dev.off()
pheatmap(
  mat_corrected,
  annotation_col = ann,
  show_rownames = FALSE,
  color = colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(9,"RdBu")))(255),
  fontsize_col = 10,
  main = "Heatmap - After Batch Correction"
)
```

## Differential Expression Analysis with LFC Shrinkage

```{r Helper functions}

#Process all contrasts
process_results <- function(res_unshrunk, res_shrunk, contrast_name) {
  
  # Convert unshrunk results to dataframe
  df <- as.data.frame(res_unshrunk)
  df$gene <- rownames(df)
  
  # Add shrunken LFC and SE
  df$lfc_shrunk  <- res_shrunk$log2FoldChange
  df$lfcSE_shrunk <- res_shrunk$lfcSE
  
  # Classify genes using:
  # - UNSHRUNKEN LFC for biological threshold
  # - UNSHRUNKEN padj for statistics
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(
      diffexpressed = case_when(
        log2FoldChange > 1 & padj < 0.05 ~ "UP",
        log2FoldChange < -1 & padj < 0.05 ~ "DOWN",
        TRUE ~ "NO"
      ),
      contrast = contrast_name
    )
  
  return(df)
}


# MODIFIED Volcano plot function - marks PBX1 and TCF3 regardless of significance
create_volcano <- function(df, contrast_name, n_label = 20) {
  # Prepare labels for top genes
  df$padj[df$padj == 0] <- 1e-300
  df <- df[!is.na(df$padj) & !is.na(df$log2FoldChange), ]
  
  # Get top significant genes (these are actual top DEGs)
  top_genes <- head(df[order(df$padj), "gene"], n_label)
  
  # Check if PBX1 and TCF3 exist in dataset and add them SEPARATELY for labeling
  special_genes <- c("PBX1", "TCF3")
  special_genes <- special_genes[special_genes %in% df$gene]
  
  # Combine top genes with special genes for labeling
  genes_to_label <- unique(c(top_genes, special_genes))
  
  df$delabel <- ifelse(df$gene %in% genes_to_label, df$gene, NA)
  
  # Create a special category for PBX1 and TCF3 for highlighting
  df$special_gene <- ifelse(df$gene %in% special_genes, df$gene, NA)
  
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = lfc_shrunk, y = -log10(padj), 
                      col = diffexpressed, label = delabel)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 1.5) +
    # Highlight PBX1 and TCF3 with larger purple diamond points
    geom_point(data = df[!is.na(df$special_gene), ],
               aes(x = lfc_shrunk, y = -log10(padj)),
               color = "purple", size = 4, shape = 18) +
    geom_text_repel(
      data = df[!is.na(df$delabel), ],
      aes(fontface = ifelse(!is.na(special_gene), "bold", "plain")),
      color = "black",
      max.overlaps = 50,
      force = 1,
      box.padding = 0.5,
      point.padding = 0.5,
      size = 3,
      seed = 42
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c("DOWN" = "blue", "NO" = "grey", "UP" = "red"),
      labels = c("Down-regulated", "Not significant", "Up-regulated")
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Differential Expression:", contrast_name, "(LFC Shrinkage Applied)"),
      x = "Shrunken Log2 Fold Change",
      y = "-Log10 Adjusted P-value",
      caption = "LFC shrinkage: 'ashr' method"
    ) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1, 1), col = "black", linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), col = "black", linetype = "dashed") +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 14),
      plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 1, face = "italic", size = 9)
    )
  
  return(p)
}

#Raw MA plots (QC control)
create_ma_plot_raw <- function(df, contrast_name) {
  
  df_filtered <- df[!is.na(df$padj) & !is.na(df$baseMean), ]
  
  p <- ggplot(df_filtered, aes(x = log10(baseMean + 1),
                               y = log2FoldChange,
                               col = diffexpressed)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 1) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("DOWN"="blue","NO"="grey","UP"="red")) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = c(-1,1), linetype="dashed") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
    labs(
      title = paste("MA Plot (RAW LFC):", contrast_name),
      x = "Log10 Mean Expression",
      y = "Raw Log2 Fold Change",
      caption = "Classical MA plot (no shrinkage)"
    ) +
    theme_classic()
  
  return(p)
}

#Shrunken MA plots for publications
create_ma_plot_shrunk <- function(df, contrast_name) {
  
  df_filtered <- df[!is.na(df$padj) & !is.na(df$baseMean), ]
  
  p <- ggplot(df_filtered, aes(x = log10(baseMean + 1),
                               y = lfc_shrunk,
                               col = diffexpressed)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 1) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("DOWN"="blue","NO"="grey","UP"="red")) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = c(-1,1), linetype="dashed") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
    labs(
      title = paste("MA Plot (Shrunken LFC):", contrast_name),
      x = "Log10 Mean Expression",
      y = "Shrunken Log2 Fold Change",
      caption = "LFC shrinkage: ashr"
    ) +
    theme_classic()
  
  return(p)
}

```

```{r Enrichment Analysis with enrichR, fig.width=10, fig.height=7}

library(enrichR)

websiteLive <- getOption("enrichR.live", TRUE)
if (websiteLive) {
  dbs_available <- listEnrichrDbs()
}

dbs <- c("GO_Biological_Process_2023",
         "KEGG_2021_Human",
         "WikiPathway_2023_Human",
         "Reactome_2022",
         "MSigDB_Hallmark_2020")

# ============================================================================
# HELPER: robust gene-list extractor
# enrichR returns genes in the Genes column separated by ";" or "; " (with space)
# depending on the database and package version. This handles both reliably.
# ============================================================================
extract_genes <- function(genes_string) {
  # Split on semicolon (with or without surrounding spaces)
  genes <- unlist(strsplit(genes_string, "\\s*;\\s*"))
  # Remove any empty strings that could arise from trailing separators
  genes <- genes[nchar(trimws(genes)) > 0]
  trimws(genes)
}

# ============================================================================
# HELPER: clean enrichR result table
# Applies term-ID stripping (GO, Reactome, WikiPathway) uniformly and
# computes gene_ratio. Works for any database.
# ============================================================================
process_enrichr_db <- function(db_result) {
  df <- db_result %>%
    separate(col = "Overlap", into = c("Gene_count", "total"), sep = "/",
             convert = TRUE, extra = "drop", fill = "right")
  df$gene_ratio <- df$Gene_count / df$total
  # Strip embedded IDs from term names (present in GO, Reactome, WikiPathway)
  df$Term <- gsub("\\s*\\(GO:\\d+\\)", "",   df$Term)
  df$Term <- gsub("\\s*R-HSA-[0-9.]+",  "",  df$Term)
  df$Term <- gsub("\\s*WP\\d+",         "",  df$Term)
  df$Term <- trimws(df$Term)
  df
}

# ============================================================================
# HELPER: save gene lists + summary TSV for one direction x database x contrast
# ============================================================================
save_enrichr_genelists <- function(sig_terms, prefix, out_dir) {
  # One summary TSV with all significant terms
  sig_out <- sig_terms %>%
    select(Term, Gene_count, total, gene_ratio, P.value, Adjusted.P.value, Genes) %>%
    arrange(Adjusted.P.value)
  write.table(sig_out,
              file.path(out_dir, paste0(prefix, "_enrichment.tsv")),
              sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)
}

# ============================================================================
# HELPER: bubble plot for enrichR results
# ============================================================================
plot_enrichr <- function(sig_terms, title_str, xlab_str) {
  plot_data <- head(sig_terms, 20)
  ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Term, y = -log10(Adjusted.P.value))) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "azure4", size = 0.5) +
    geom_point(aes(size = Gene_count, colour = gene_ratio), alpha = 0.7) +
    scale_x_discrete(limits = rev(plot_data$Term)) +
    scale_color_gradient(low = "green", high = "red", limits = c(0, NA)) +
    coord_flip() +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(axis.ticks.length    = unit(-0.1, "cm"),
          axis.text.x          = element_text(margin = margin(5, 5, 0, 5, "pt")),
          axis.text.y          = element_text(margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5, "pt")),
          axis.text            = element_text(color = "black"),
          panel.grid.minor     = element_blank(),
          legend.title.align   = 0.5,
          plot.title           = element_text(hjust = 0.5, color = "black",
                                              face = "bold", size = 14)) +
    xlab(xlab_str) +
    ylab("-log10(Adjusted P-value)") +
    labs(color = "Gene Ratio", size = "Number\nof genes") +
    ggtitle(title_str)
}

# ============================================================================
# MAIN LOOP
# ============================================================================
all_enrichr_results <- list()

for (contrast_name in names(all_results)) {
  
  cat("\n=== Processing enrichR for:", contrast_name, "===\n")
  
  df       <- all_results[[contrast_name]]
  dge_up   <- subset(df, diffexpressed == "UP")
  dge_down <- subset(df, diffexpressed == "DOWN")
  cat("UP genes:", nrow(dge_up), "| DOWN genes:", nrow(dge_down), "\n")
  
  for (direction in c("UP", "DOWN")) {
    
    dge_set <- if (direction == "UP") dge_up else dge_down
    if (nrow(dge_set) == 0 || !websiteLive) next
    
    enriched <- enrichr(as.vector(dge_set$gene), dbs)
    all_enrichr_results[[paste0(contrast_name, "_", direction)]] <- enriched
    
    for (db_idx in seq_along(dbs)) {
      db_name <- dbs[db_idx]
      
      if (is.null(enriched[[db_idx]]) || nrow(enriched[[db_idx]]) == 0) next
      
      # Process: clean terms + compute gene_ratio
      enriched_processed <- process_enrichr_db(enriched[[db_idx]])
      sig_terms <- subset(enriched_processed, Adjusted.P.value < 0.05)
      
      if (nrow(sig_terms) == 0) {
        cat("  No significant results for", db_name, direction, "\n")
        next
      }
      
      # File prefix: <contrast>_<direction>_<db>
      file_prefix <- paste0(contrast_name, "_", direction, "_", db_name)
      
      # Save gene lists + summary TSV
      save_enrichr_genelists(sig_terms, file_prefix, contrasts_genelists_dir)
      
      # Plot + save
      p <- plot_enrichr(
        sig_terms,
        title_str = paste(db_name, "-", contrast_name, paste0("(", direction, ")")),
        xlab_str  = paste(db_name, "Terms", paste0("(", direction, ")"))
      )
      print(p)
      ggsave(
        file.path(contrasts_dir,
                  paste0("enrichR_", db_name, "_", direction, "_", contrast_name, ".pdf")),
        p, width = 10, height = 7
      )
      cat("  Plot + gene lists saved for", db_name, direction, "\n")
    }
  }
}

cat("\n=== enrichR analysis completed for all contrasts ===\n")
```

```{r Kmeans heatmap per samples}
cat("\n=== Creating DEG Heatmap: K-means clustering ===\n\n")

# MANUAL OVERRIDE
optimal_k <- 8
set.seed(42)

# K-means clustering
km_result <- kmeans(mat_all_deg_scaled, centers = optimal_k, nstart = 25, iter.max = 100)
clusters <- km_result$cluster

# Calculate mean expression per cluster per condition
ep1_samples <- rownames(coldata)[coldata$condition == "EP1"]
aro_samples <- rownames(coldata)[coldata$condition == "Aro"]
reh_samples <- rownames(coldata)[coldata$condition == "REH"]

cluster_stats <- data.frame(
  Cluster = 1:optimal_k,
  Mean_EP1 = NA,
  Mean_Aro = NA,
  Mean_REH = NA,
  N_genes = NA
)
for (k in 1:optimal_k) {
  genes_in_cluster <- names(clusters)[clusters == k]
  cluster_stats$N_genes[k] <- length(genes_in_cluster)
  cluster_stats$Mean_EP1[k] <- mean(mat_all_deg_scaled[genes_in_cluster, ep1_samples], na.rm = TRUE)
  cluster_stats$Mean_Aro[k] <- mean(mat_all_deg_scaled[genes_in_cluster, aro_samples], na.rm = TRUE)
  cluster_stats$Mean_REH[k] <- mean(mat_all_deg_scaled[genes_in_cluster, reh_samples], na.rm = TRUE)
}

cluster_order <- order(cluster_stats$Mean_REH)
col_order <- c(reh_samples, ep1_samples, aro_samples)
mat_reordered <- mat_all_deg_scaled[, col_order]

genes_ordered <- unlist(lapply(cluster_order, function(k) {
  genes <- names(clusters)[clusters == k]
  ep1_vs_reh <- rowMeans(mat_reordered[genes, ep1_samples, drop = FALSE]) -
                rowMeans(mat_reordered[genes, reh_samples, drop = FALSE])
  genes[order(ep1_vs_reh)]
}))

mat_final <- mat_reordered[genes_ordered, ]

# Annotations
ann_col <- data.frame(
  condition = sapply(colnames(mat_final), function(x) {
    if (x %in% ep1_samples) return("EP1")
    else if (x %in% aro_samples) return("Aro")
    else if (x %in% reh_samples) return("REH")
    else return("Unknown")
  }),
  row.names = colnames(mat_final)
)
```

```{r Cluster enrichment}
        enriched_processed <- process_enrichr_db(enriched_cluster[[db_idx]])
        
        sig_terms <- subset(enriched_processed, Adjusted.P.value < 0.05)
        if (nrow(sig_terms) > 0) {
          
          # Save gene lists + summary TSV using shared helper (handles ";" and "; " separators)

    }
  }
```

```{r ChIP-seq Peak to TSS Distance Analysis}
cat("\n=== ChIP-SEQ PEAK TO TSS DISTANCE ANALYSIS ===\n\n")

library(GenomicRanges)
library(TxDb.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38.knownGene)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)

# chip_path <- "/mnt/beegfs/xvilchez/chip_publicdata/697HF_E2APBX1-HF_peaks.bed"
chip_path <- "R:/R_STIK/chip_seq/Xavi_TFM/697HF_E2APBX1-HF_peaks.bed"

if (!file.exists(chip_path)) {
  stop("ChIP-seq peak file not found at: ", chip_path)
}

peaks_df <- read.table(chip_path, header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
colnames(peaks_df)[1:3] <- c("chr", "start", "end")

peaks_gr <- GRanges(
  seqnames = peaks_df$chr,
  ranges = IRanges(start = peaks_df$start, end = peaks_df$end)
)

cat(paste0("Loaded ", length(peaks_gr), " ChIP-seq peaks\n"))

txdb <- TxDb.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38.knownGene
genes_gr <- genes(txdb)

gene_symbols <- mapIds(
  org.Hs.eg.db,
  keys = names(genes_gr),
  column = "SYMBOL",
  keytype = "ENTREZID",
  multiVals = "first"
)

genes_gr$symbol <- gene_symbols[names(genes_gr)]
genes_gr <- genes_gr[!is.na(genes_gr$symbol)]

cat(paste0("Loaded ", length(genes_gr), " genes with TSS coordinates\n\n"))

get_tss <- function(gr) {
  tss <- gr
  strand_vec <- as.character(strand(gr))
  plus_strand  <- strand_vec == "+"
  minus_strand <- strand_vec == "-"
  start(tss)[plus_strand]  <- start(gr)[plus_strand]
  end(tss)[plus_strand]    <- start(gr)[plus_strand]
  start(tss)[minus_strand] <- end(gr)[minus_strand]
  end(tss)[minus_strand]   <- end(gr)[minus_strand]
  return(tss)
}

tss_gr <- get_tss(genes_gr)

max_distance <- 1e6

cluster_peak_analysis <- list()

for (k in 1:optimal_k) {
  cat(paste0("=== Analyzing Cluster ", k, " ===\n"))
  cluster_genes <- names(clusters)[clusters == k]
  cluster_tss   <- tss_gr[tss_gr$symbol %in% cluster_genes]
  cat(paste0("  Cluster has ", length(cluster_genes), " genes\n"))
  cat(paste0("  ", length(cluster_tss), " genes with TSS coordinates\n"))
  
  nearest_peaks   <- distanceToNearest(cluster_tss, peaks_gr, ignore.strand = TRUE)
  distances       <- mcols(nearest_peaks)$distance
  within_threshold <- distances <= max_distance
  
  n_genes_total   <- length(cluster_tss)
  n_genes_with_peak <- sum(within_threshold)
  pct_with_peak   <- (n_genes_with_peak / n_genes_total) * 100
  avg_distance    <- mean(distances[within_threshold])
  median_distance <- median(distances[within_threshold])
  
  cluster_peak_analysis[[k]] <- list(
    cluster = k,
    n_genes_total = n_genes_total,
    n_genes_with_peak = n_genes_with_peak,
    pct_with_peak = pct_with_peak,
    avg_distance = avg_distance,
    median_distance = median_distance,
    distances = distances[within_threshold],
    all_distances = distances
  )
  
  cat(paste0("  Genes with peak within 1 Mb: ", n_genes_with_peak, 
             " (", round(pct_with_peak, 2), "%)\n"))
  cat(paste0("  Average distance: ", round(avg_distance, 2), " bp\n"))
  cat(paste0("  Median distance: ", round(median_distance, 2), " bp\n\n"))
}

summary_peak_table <- data.frame(
  Cluster = 1:optimal_k,
  N_Genes = sapply(cluster_peak_analysis, function(x) x$n_genes_total),
  N_With_Peak = sapply(cluster_peak_analysis, function(x) x$n_genes_with_peak),
  Percent_With_Peak = sapply(cluster_peak_analysis, function(x) round(x$pct_with_peak, 2)),
  Avg_Distance_bp = sapply(cluster_peak_analysis, function(x) round(x$avg_distance, 2)),
  Median_Distance_bp = sapply(cluster_peak_analysis, function(x) round(x$median_distance, 2))
)

cat("\n=== SUMMARY TABLE ===\n")
print(summary_peak_table)

write.table(
  summary_peak_table,
  file.path(clusters_dir, "ChIP_peak_TSS_analysis_summary.tsv"),
  sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE
)
cat("ChIP peak TSS analysis summary saved to Clusters/\n")

# Statistical tests
cat("\n=== STATISTICAL TESTS ===\n\n")
contingency_table <- matrix(
  c(summary_peak_table$N_With_Peak, 
    summary_peak_table$N_Genes - summary_peak_table$N_With_Peak),
  nrow = optimal_k
)
chi_test <- chisq.test(contingency_table)
cat("Chi-square test for differences in peak association across clusters:\n")
print(chi_test)

all_distances_list <- lapply(cluster_peak_analysis, function(x) x$distances)
names(all_distances_list) <- paste0("Cluster_", 1:optimal_k)

distance_df <- data.frame(
  distance = unlist(all_distances_list),
  cluster  = factor(rep(names(all_distances_list), sapply(all_distances_list, length)))
)

kw_test <- kruskal.test(distance ~ cluster, data = distance_df)
cat("Kruskal-Wallis test for differences in peak-TSS distances:\n")
print(kw_test)

if (kw_test$p.value < 0.05) {
  cat("Performing pairwise Wilcoxon tests (Bonferroni correction):\n")
  pairwise_test <- pairwise.wilcox.test(
    distance_df$distance, distance_df$cluster, p.adjust.method = "bonferroni"
  )
  print(pairwise_test)
}

# Plots saved to Clusters/
p_bar <- ggplot(summary_peak_table, 
                aes(x = factor(Cluster), y = Percent_With_Peak, fill = factor(Cluster))) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(Percent_With_Peak, 1), "%")), vjust = -0.5, size = 4) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set3") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  labs(title = "Percentage of Genes with E2A-PBX1 Peaks within 1 Mb of TSS",
       x = "Cluster", y = "Percentage of Genes (%)")
print(p_bar)
ggsave(file.path(clusters_dir, "ChIP_pct_genes_with_peak.pdf"), p_bar, width = 8, height = 6)

library(ggpubr)
p_box <- ggplot(distance_df, aes(x = cluster, y = distance/1000, fill = cluster)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set3") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(title = "Distribution of Peak-TSS Distances by Cluster",
       subtitle = "Only genes with peaks within 1 Mb",
       x = "Cluster", y = "Distance to Nearest Peak (kb)") +
  stat_compare_means(method = "kruskal.test", label.y = max(distance_df$distance/1000) * 0.95)
print(p_box)
ggsave(file.path(clusters_dir, "ChIP_peak_TSS_distance_boxplot.pdf"), p_box, width = 8, height = 6)

p_violin <- ggplot(distance_df, aes(x = cluster, y = distance/1000, fill = cluster)) +
  geom_violin(alpha = 0.6, trim = FALSE) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set3") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(title = "Peak-TSS Distance Distribution by Cluster",
       x = "Cluster", y = "Distance to Nearest Peak (kb)")
print(p_violin)
ggsave(file.path(clusters_dir, "ChIP_peak_TSS_distance_violin.pdf"), p_violin, width = 8, height = 6)

cat("\n=== CHIP ANALYSIS COMPLETE — plots saved to Clusters/ ===\n")
```

```{r HOMER Motif Analysis Preparation}
cat("\n=== PREPARING DATA FOR HOMER MOTIF ANALYSIS ===\n\n")

library(GenomicRanges)
library(TxDb.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38.knownGene)

# Use the structured sub-folder defined at the top
homer_dir <- homer_promoter_dir

promoter_upstream   <- 2000
promoter_downstream <- 500

cat(paste0("Promoter regions: -", promoter_upstream, " to +", promoter_downstream, " bp from TSS\n"))
cat(paste0("Output directory: ", homer_dir, "\n\n"))

cat("=== Exporting Cluster Promoters ===\n")

for (k in 1:optimal_k) {
  cluster_genes      <- names(clusters)[clusters == k]
  cluster_gene_gr    <- genes_gr[genes_gr$symbol %in% cluster_genes]
  cluster_promoters  <- promoters(cluster_gene_gr, upstream = promoter_upstream,
                                  downstream = promoter_downstream)
  
  promoter_df <- data.frame(
    chr    = as.character(seqnames(cluster_promoters)),
    start  = start(cluster_promoters),
    end    = end(cluster_promoters),
    name   = cluster_promoters$symbol,
    score  = 0,
    strand = as.character(strand(cluster_promoters))
  )
  promoter_df <- promoter_df[complete.cases(promoter_df), ]
  
  bed_file <- file.path(homer_dir, paste0("cluster_", k, "_promoters.bed"))
  write.table(promoter_df, bed_file, sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE)
  cat(paste0("Cluster ", k, ": ", nrow(promoter_df), " promoters -> ", basename(bed_file), "\n"))
}

# Background: all DEGs
cat("\n=== Background: All DEGs ===\n")
all_deg_genes_bg  <- rownames(mat_all_deg_scaled)
background_gene_gr <- genes_gr[genes_gr$symbol %in% all_deg_genes_bg]
background_promoters <- promoters(background_gene_gr, upstream = promoter_upstream,
                                   downstream = promoter_downstream)
background_deg_df <- data.frame(
  chr    = as.character(seqnames(background_promoters)),
  start  = start(background_promoters),
  end    = end(background_promoters),
  name   = background_promoters$symbol,
  score  = 0,
  strand = as.character(strand(background_promoters))
)
background_deg_df <- background_deg_df[complete.cases(background_deg_df), ]
background_deg_file <- file.path(homer_dir, "background_all_DEGs.bed")
write.table(background_deg_df, background_deg_file, sep = "\t", quote = FALSE,
            row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE)
cat(paste0("  ", nrow(background_deg_df), " promoters -> background_all_DEGs.bed\n"))

cat("\nHOMER BED files ready in: ", homer_dir, "\n")
```

```{r HOMER Visualizations, fig.width=12, fig.height=10}

library(dplyr)
library(readr)

homer_results_list <- list()

for (k in 1:optimal_k) {
  file_path <- file.path(homer_dir, paste0("cluster_", k, "_DEGbg/knownResults.txt"))
  if (file.exists(file_path)) {
    df <- read_tsv(file_path, comment = "#")
    df$Cluster <- k
    homer_results_list[[k]] <- df
  }
}

homer_combined <- bind_rows(homer_results_list)

homer_combined <- homer_combined %>%
  mutate(Motif_Clean = gsub("\\(.*", "", `Motif Name`)) %>%
  mutate(Motif_Clean = trimws(Motif_Clean))

homer_combined <- homer_combined %>%
  rename(Percent_Target = `...6`)
homer_combined$Percent_Target <- as.numeric(gsub("%", "", homer_combined$Percent_Target))

cat("\n=== HOMER PROMOTER MOTIF VISUALIZATIONS ===\n\n")

# 1. Heatmap
significant_motifs <- homer_combined %>%
  filter(`P-value` < 0.05) %>%
  group_by(Motif_Clean) %>%
  summarise(min_pval = min(`P-value`), n_clusters_sig = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(min_pval) %>%
  head(40) %>%
  pull(Motif_Clean)

if (length(significant_motifs) > 0) {
  motif_matrix_improved <- homer_combined %>%
    filter(Motif_Clean %in% significant_motifs) %>%
    group_by(Motif_Clean, Cluster) %>%
    slice_min(`P-value`, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(neg_log_p = pmin(-log10(`P-value`), 50)) %>%
    select(Motif_Clean, Cluster, neg_log_p) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Cluster, values_from = neg_log_p, values_fill = 0)
  
  motif_matrix_df <- as.data.frame(motif_matrix_improved)
  rownames(motif_matrix_df) <- motif_matrix_df$Motif_Clean
  motif_matrix_df$Motif_Clean <- NULL
  motif_matrix_final <- as.matrix(motif_matrix_df)
  motif_matrix_final <- motif_matrix_final[, order(as.numeric(colnames(motif_matrix_final)))]
  
  pdf(file.path(homer_promoter_dir, "motif_heatmap_promoters.pdf"), width = 12, height = 14)
  pheatmap(motif_matrix_final, cluster_rows = TRUE, cluster_cols = FALSE,
    color = colorRampPalette(c("white","yellow","orange","red","darkred"))(100),
    main = "Top Enriched Motifs Across Clusters\n(-log10 P-value, only p<0.05)",
    display_numbers = FALSE, fontsize_row = 7, fontsize_col = 11,
    angle_col = 0, border_color = "grey90", cellwidth = 35, cellheight = 10,
    breaks = seq(0, max(motif_matrix_final), length.out = 101))
  dev.off()
  pheatmap(motif_matrix_final, cluster_rows = TRUE, cluster_cols = FALSE,
    color = colorRampPalette(c("white","yellow","orange","red","darkred"))(100),
    main = "Top Enriched Motifs Across Clusters\n(-log10 P-value, only p<0.05)",
    display_numbers = FALSE, fontsize_row = 7, fontsize_col = 11,
    angle_col = 0, border_color = "grey90", cellwidth = 35, cellheight = 10,
    breaks = seq(0, max(motif_matrix_final), length.out = 101))
}

# 2. Dot plot
top_motifs_per_cluster <- homer_combined %>%
  group_by(Cluster) %>% arrange(`P-value`) %>% slice_head(n = 10) %>% ungroup() %>%
  group_by(Motif_Clean, Cluster) %>% slice_min(`P-value`, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>% ungroup()

p_dot <- ggplot(top_motifs_per_cluster, aes(x = factor(Cluster), y = Motif_Clean)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = -log10(`P-value`), color = -log10(`P-value`),
                 alpha = ifelse(`P-value` < 0.05, 1, 0.3))) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(1, 10), name = "-log10(P-value)") +
  scale_color_gradient(low = "lightblue", high = "darkred", name = "-log10(P-value)") +
  scale_alpha_identity() +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(title = "Top 10 Motifs Per Cluster (Dot Plot)", x = "Cluster", y = "Motif")
print(p_dot)
ggsave(file.path(homer_promoter_dir, "motif_dotplot_promoters.pdf"), p_dot, width = 12, height = 10)

# 3. Cluster enrichment summary bar
cluster_enrichment_stats <- homer_combined %>%
  group_by(Cluster) %>%
  summarise(n_significant = sum(`P-value` < 0.05), n_very_significant = sum(`P-value` < 0.001),
            median_pval = median(`P-value`), min_pval = min(`P-value`), .groups = "drop") %>%
```

```{r TF-family-plots promoters, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
tf_families <- list(
  "E2A/TCF" = c("E2A","TCF","E47","E12"),
  "PBX"     = c("PBX1","PBX2","PBX3","PBX"),
  "HOX"     = c("HOXA","HOXB","HOXC","HOXD","HOX"),

  "RUNX"    = c("RUNX","AML"),
  "MYC"     = c("MYC","MYCN","MAX")
)

tf_family_enrichment <- list()
for (family_name in names(tf_families)) {
  patterns <- tf_families[[family_name]]
  family_results <- homer_combined %>%
    filter(grepl(paste(patterns, collapse = "|"), Motif_Clean, ignore.case = TRUE)) %>%
    group_by(Cluster, Motif_Clean) %>% slice_min(`P-value`, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>% ungroup() %>%
    mutate(TF_Family = family_name, neg_log_p = -log10(`P-value`))
  tf_family_enrichment[[family_name]] <- family_results
}
tf_family_combined <- bind_rows(tf_family_enrichment)

tf_heatmap_plot <- NULL
tf_dot_plot <- NULL

if (nrow(tf_family_combined) > 0) {

  # Create summary matrix for heatmap
tf_summary <- tf_family_combined %>%
  group_by(TF_Family, Cluster) %>%
  summarise(max_neg_log_p = max(neg_log_p), .groups = "drop")

tf_summary_matrix <- tf_summary %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Cluster,
              values_from = max_neg_log_p,
              values_fill = 0) %>%
  column_to_rownames("TF_Family") %>%
  as.matrix()

  # Save heatmap

           cluster_rows = FALSE, cluster_cols = FALSE,
           color = colorRampPalette(c("white","pink","red","darkred"))(100),
           main = "TF Family Enrichment Across Clusters\n(Max -log10 P-value per family)",
           display_numbers = TRUE, number_format = "%.1f",
           fontsize = 11, angle_col = 0,
           cellwidth = 40, cellheight = 30,
           filename = file.path(homer_promoter_dir, "TF_family_heatmap_promoters.pdf"),
           width = 10, height = 6)

  # Create heatmap object for display
  tf_heatmap_plot <- pheatmap(tf_summary_matrix,
                              cluster_rows = FALSE, cluster_cols = FALSE,
                              color = colorRampPalette(c("white","pink","red","darkred"))(100),
                              main = "TF Family Enrichment Across Clusters\n(Max -log10 P-value per family)",
                              display_numbers = TRUE, number_format = "%.1f",
                              fontsize = 11, angle_col = 0,
                              cellwidth = 40, cellheight = 30)

  tf_sig <- tf_family_combined %>% filter(`P-value` < 0.05)

  if (nrow(tf_sig) > 0) {

    tf_dot_plot <- ggplot(tf_sig,
                          aes(x = factor(Cluster), y = TF_Family)) +
      geom_point(aes(size = neg_log_p, color = neg_log_p)) +
      scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 12)) +
      scale_color_gradient(low = "lightblue", high = "darkred") +

      labs(title = "TF Family Enrichment by Cluster",
           subtitle = "Only showing p < 0.05",
           x = "Cluster", y = "TF Family")

    ggsave(file.path(homer_promoter_dir,
                     "TF_family_dotplot_promoters.pdf"),
           tf_dot_plot, width = 8, height = 6)
  }
}

# ---- PRINT OUTSIDE IF BLOCK ----
```

```{r HOMER Motif Analysis on ChIP Peaks Near Cluster TSS, fig.width=10, fig.height=8}
cat(paste0("Distance threshold: ", format(max_distance, big.mark = ","), " bp\n"))
cat(paste0("Output directory: ", homer_peaks_dir, "\n\n"))

# STEP 1: Extract peaks near TSS for each cluster
cat("=== STEP 1: Extracting cluster-specific ChIP peaks ===\n\n")

cluster_peak_indices <- list()

for (k in 1:optimal_k) {
  cat(paste0("Processing Cluster ", k, "...\n"))
  cluster_genes <- names(clusters)[clusters == k]
  cluster_tss   <- tss_gr[tss_gr$symbol %in% cluster_genes]
  
  cat(paste0("  Genes in cluster: ", length(cluster_genes), "\n"))
  cat(paste0("  Genes with TSS:   ", length(cluster_tss), "\n"))
  
  hits              <- distanceToNearest(cluster_tss, peaks_gr, ignore.strand = TRUE)
  within_threshold  <- mcols(hits)$distance <= max_distance
  hits_filtered     <- hits[within_threshold]
  near_peak_idx     <- unique(subjectHits(hits_filtered))
  cluster_peak_indices[[k]] <- near_peak_idx
  
  cat(paste0("  TSS within ", format(max_distance, big.mark=","), " bp of a peak: ",
             sum(within_threshold), "\n"))
  cat(paste0("  Unique peaks selected: ", length(near_peak_idx), "\n\n"))
}

# STEP 2: Write per-cluster peak BED files
cat("=== STEP 2: Writing cluster peak BED files ===\n\n")

peaks_to_bed <- function(gr) {
  data.frame(chr = as.character(seqnames(gr)), start = start(gr), end = end(gr),
             name = paste0("peak_", seq_along(gr)), score = 0, strand = ".",
             stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}

for (k in 1:optimal_k) {
  idx              <- cluster_peak_indices[[k]]
  cluster_peaks_gr <- peaks_gr[idx]
  bed_df           <- peaks_to_bed(cluster_peaks_gr)
  bed_file         <- file.path(homer_peaks_dir, paste0("cluster_", k, "_chip_peaks.bed"))
  write.table(bed_df, bed_file, sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE)
  cat(paste0("Cluster ", k, ": ", nrow(bed_df), " peaks -> ", basename(bed_file), "\n"))
}

# STEP 3: Background BED files
cat("\n=== STEP 3: Building background BED files ===\n\n")

all_peaks_bed <- peaks_to_bed(peaks_gr)
bg_all_file   <- file.path(homer_peaks_dir, "background_all_chip_peaks.bed")
write.table(all_peaks_bed, bg_all_file, sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE)
cat(paste0("Background A (all peaks): ", nrow(all_peaks_bed), " peaks\n"))

all_deg_genes_bgc <- rownames(mat_all_deg_scaled)
all_deg_tss       <- tss_gr[tss_gr$symbol %in% all_deg_genes_bgc]
hits_all_deg      <- distanceToNearest(all_deg_tss, peaks_gr, ignore.strand = TRUE)
within_all_deg    <- mcols(hits_all_deg)$distance <= max_distance
near_deg_idx      <- unique(subjectHits(hits_all_deg[within_all_deg]))

deg_peaks_bed <- peaks_to_bed(peaks_gr[near_deg_idx])
bg_deg_file   <- file.path(homer_peaks_dir, "background_deg_chip_peaks.bed")
write.table(deg_peaks_bed, bg_deg_file, sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE)
cat(paste0("Background B (peaks near any DEG TSS): ", nrow(deg_peaks_bed), " peaks\n"))

# STEP 4: Overlap summary
cat("\n=== STEP 4: Peak overlap summary across clusters ===\n\n")

overlap_summary <- data.frame(
  Cluster          = 1:optimal_k,
  N_Peaks_Selected = sapply(cluster_peak_indices, length),
  Pct_Of_AllPeaks  = round(sapply(cluster_peak_indices, length) / length(peaks_gr) * 100, 2)
)

jaccard <- function(a, b) length(intersect(a, b)) / length(union(a, b))
jaccard_mat <- matrix(NA, nrow = optimal_k, ncol = optimal_k,
                      dimnames = list(paste0("C", 1:optimal_k), paste0("C", 1:optimal_k)))
for (i in 1:optimal_k)
  for (j in 1:optimal_k)
    jaccard_mat[i, j] <- round(jaccard(cluster_peak_indices[[i]], cluster_peak_indices[[j]]), 3)

cat("Peaks selected per cluster:\n"); print(overlap_summary)
cat("\nJaccard similarity between cluster peak sets:\n"); print(jaccard_mat)

write.table(overlap_summary,
  file.path(homer_peaks_dir, "cluster_chip_peak_overlap_summary.tsv"),
  sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)

# Print HOMER commands
cat("\n", strrep("=", 80), "\n", sep = "")
cat("HOMER COMMANDS (run from terminal):\n")
cat(strrep("=", 80), "\n\n")
cat(paste0("cd ", homer_peaks_dir, "\n\n"))
cat("# RECOMMENDED: cluster peaks vs. DEG background\n")
for (k in 1:optimal_k) {
  cat(sprintf("findMotifsGenome.pl cluster_%d_chip_peaks.bed hg38 cluster_%d_chip_DEGbg -size given -mask -bg background_deg_chip_peaks.bed -p 4\n", k, k))
}
cat("\n# ALTERNATIVE: cluster peaks vs. all ChIP peaks\n")
for (k in 1:optimal_k) {
  cat(sprintf("findMotifsGenome.pl cluster_%d_chip_peaks.bed hg38 cluster_%d_chip_allbg -size given -mask -bg background_all_chip_peaks.bed -p 4\n", k, k))
}
cat("\n=== ChIP PEAK HOMER INPUT PREPARATION COMPLETE ===\n")
cat(paste0("BED files saved to: ", homer_peaks_dir, "\n\n"))
```

```{r HOMER ChIP Peak Motif Visualizations, fig.width=12, fig.height=10}

cat("\n=== HOMER ChIP PEAK MOTIF VISUALIZATIONS ===\n\n")

library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(pheatmap)

homer_peaks_results_list <- list()

for (k in 1:optimal_k) {
  file_path <- file.path(homer_peaks_dir, paste0("cluster_", k, "_chip_DEGbg/knownResults.txt"))
  if (file.exists(file_path)) {
    df <- read_tsv(file_path, comment = "#", show_col_types = FALSE)
    df$Cluster <- k
    homer_peaks_results_list[[k]] <- df
    cat(paste0("Loaded cluster ", k, ": ", nrow(df), " motifs\n"))
  } else {
    cat(paste0("WARNING: File not found for cluster ", k, ": ", file_path, "\n"))
  }
}

if (length(homer_peaks_results_list) == 0) {
  stop("No HOMER ChIP peak results found. Run HOMER first.")
}

homer_peaks_combined <- bind_rows(homer_peaks_results_list) %>%
  mutate(Motif_Clean = trimws(gsub("\\(.*", "", `Motif Name`))) %>%
  rename(Percent_Target = `...6`)
homer_peaks_combined$Percent_Target <- as.numeric(gsub("%", "", homer_peaks_combined$Percent_Target))

cat(paste0("Total motif-cluster rows: ", nrow(homer_peaks_combined), "\n"))

# 1. Heatmap
significant_motifs_peaks <- homer_peaks_combined %>%
  filter(`P-value` < 0.05) %>%
  group_by(Motif_Clean) %>%
  summarise(min_pval = min(`P-value`), n_clusters_sig = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(min_pval) %>% head(40) %>% pull(Motif_Clean)

if (length(significant_motifs_peaks) > 0) {
  motif_matrix_peaks <- homer_peaks_combined %>%
    filter(Motif_Clean %in% significant_motifs_peaks) %>%
    group_by(Motif_Clean, Cluster) %>% slice_min(`P-value`, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>% ungroup() %>%
    mutate(neg_log_p = pmin(-log10(`P-value`), 50)) %>%
    select(Motif_Clean, Cluster, neg_log_p) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Cluster, values_from = neg_log_p, values_fill = 0)
  
  motif_mat_df <- as.data.frame(motif_matrix_peaks)
  rownames(motif_mat_df) <- motif_mat_df$Motif_Clean
  motif_mat_df$Motif_Clean <- NULL
  motif_mat_final <- as.matrix(motif_mat_df)
  motif_mat_final <- motif_mat_final[, order(as.numeric(colnames(motif_mat_final)))]
  
  pdf(file.path(homer_chip_dir, "motif_heatmap_chip_peaks.pdf"), width = 12, height = 14)
  pheatmap(motif_mat_final, cluster_rows = TRUE, cluster_cols = FALSE,
    color = colorRampPalette(c("white","yellow","orange","red","darkred"))(100),
    main = "Top Enriched Motifs in ChIP Peaks Across Clusters\n(-log10 P-value, only p < 0.05)",
    display_numbers = FALSE, fontsize_row = 7, fontsize_col = 11,
    angle_col = 0, border_color = "grey90", cellwidth = 35, cellheight = 10,
    breaks = seq(0, max(motif_mat_final), length.out = 101))
  dev.off()
  pheatmap(motif_mat_final, cluster_rows = TRUE, cluster_cols = FALSE,
    color = colorRampPalette(c("white","yellow","orange","red","darkred"))(100),
    main = "Top Enriched Motifs in ChIP Peaks Across Clusters\n(-log10 P-value, only p < 0.05)",
    display_numbers = FALSE, fontsize_row = 7, fontsize_col = 11,
    angle_col = 0, border_color = "grey90", cellwidth = 35, cellheight = 10,
    breaks = seq(0, max(motif_mat_final), length.out = 101))
}

# 2. Dot plot
top_motifs_peaks <- homer_peaks_combined %>%
  group_by(Cluster) %>% arrange(`P-value`) %>% slice_head(n = 10) %>% ungroup() %>%
  group_by(Motif_Clean, Cluster) %>% slice_min(`P-value`, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>% ungroup()

p_peaks_dot <- ggplot(top_motifs_peaks, aes(x = factor(Cluster), y = Motif_Clean)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = -log10(`P-value`), color = -log10(`P-value`),
                 alpha = ifelse(`P-value` < 0.05, 1, 0.3))) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(1, 10), name = "-log10(P-value)") +
  scale_color_gradient(low = "lightblue", high = "darkred", name = "-log10(P-value)") +
  scale_alpha_identity() + theme_bw() +
  labs(title = "Top 10 Motifs Per Cluster — ChIP Peaks (Dot Plot)", x = "Cluster", y = "Motif")
print(p_peaks_dot)
ggsave(file.path(homer_chip_dir, "motif_dotplot_chip_peaks.pdf"), p_peaks_dot, width = 12, height = 10)

# 3. Enrichment summary bar
cluster_peaks_enrichment_stats <- homer_peaks_combined %>%
  group_by(Cluster) %>%
  summarise(n_significant = sum(`P-value` < 0.05), n_very_significant = sum(`P-value` < 0.001),
            median_pval = median(`P-value`), min_pval = min(`P-value`), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(n_significant))
print(cluster_peaks_enrichment_stats)

p_peaks_cluster_summary <- ggplot(cluster_peaks_enrichment_stats,
  aes(x = factor(Cluster), y = n_significant, fill = factor(Cluster))) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  geom_text(aes(label = n_significant), vjust = -0.5, size = 5, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set3") + theme_bw() + theme(legend.position = "none") +
  labs(title = "Significant Motifs per Cluster — ChIP Peaks",
       subtitle = "Count of motifs with p < 0.05", x = "Cluster", y = "Number of Significant Motifs")
print(p_peaks_cluster_summary)
ggsave(file.path(homer_chip_dir, "motif_sig_count_per_cluster_chip_peaks.pdf"),
       p_peaks_cluster_summary, width = 8, height = 6)
```

```{r Loop Anchor Gene Analysis, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
cat("\n=== LOOP ANCHOR GENE ANALYSIS ===\n\n")

# loop_dir <- "/ijc/LABS/STIK/RAW/Hi-C/HiC_marta_Oct25/loops/intersected_loops/gene_intersection"
loop_dir <- "R:/R_STIK/Hi-C/HiC_marta_Oct25/loops/intersected_loops/gene_intersection"

loop_files <- list(
  EP1_specific = list(
    file = "EP1_specific_only_05_10kb_exp30kb_anchors_GENES.bed",
    contrasts = c("EP1_vs_REH", "EP1_vs_Aro"), type = "specific"
  ),

    file = "ARO_specific_only_05_10kb_exp30kb_anchors_GENES.bed",
    contrasts = c("Aro_vs_REH", "EP1_vs_Aro"), type = "specific"
  ),
  REH_specific = list(
    file = "REH_specific_only_05_10kb_exp30kb_anchors_GENES.bed",
    contrasts = c("EP1_vs_REH", "Aro_vs_REH"), type = "specific"
  ),
  shared_EP1_Aro = list(
    file = "shared_EP1_ARO_only_05_10kb_exp30kb_anchors_GENES.bed",
    contrasts = "EP1_vs_Aro", type = "shared"
  ),
  shared_EP1_REH = list(
    file = "shared_EP1_REH_only_05_10kb_exp30kb_anchors_GENES.bed",
    contrasts = "EP1_vs_REH", type = "shared"
  ),
  shared_Aro_REH = list(
    file = "shared_ARO_REH_only_05_10kb_exp30kb_anchors_GENES.bed",
    contrasts = "Aro_vs_REH", type = "shared"
  ),
  shared_all3 = list(
    file = "shared_loops_all3_05_10kb_exp30kb_anchors_GENES.bed",
    contrasts = c("EP1_vs_REH", "Aro_vs_REH", "EP1_vs_Aro"), type = "shared"
  )
)

loop_data <- list()

for (loop_name in names(loop_files)) {
  file_path <- file.path(loop_dir, loop_files[[loop_name]]$file)
  if (file.exists(file_path)) {
    bed_data <- read.table(file_path, header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    genes    <- unique(bed_data$V5)
    cat(paste0(loop_name, ": ", length(genes), " unique genes\n"))
    loop_data[[loop_name]] <- list(
      genes = genes,
      contrasts = loop_files[[loop_name]]$contrasts,
      type = loop_files[[loop_name]]$type
    )
  } else {
    cat(paste0("Warning: File not found - ", file_path, "\n"))
  }
}
cat("\n")

lfc_results <- list()

for (loop_name in names(loop_data)) {
  genes      <- loop_data[[loop_name]]$genes
  contrasts  <- loop_data[[loop_name]]$contrasts
  loop_type  <- loop_data[[loop_name]]$type
  
  for (contrast_name in contrasts) {
    if (contrast_name %in% names(all_results)) {
      df_contrast <- all_results[[contrast_name]]
      df_filtered <- df_contrast %>%
        filter(gene %in% genes) %>%
        mutate(abs_lfc = abs(log2FoldChange), loop_category = loop_name,
               loop_type = loop_type, contrast = contrast_name) %>%
        select(gene, log2FoldChange, abs_lfc, padj, diffexpressed,
               loop_category, loop_type, contrast)
      
      key <- paste0(loop_name, "_", contrast_name)
      lfc_results[[key]] <- df_filtered
      cat(paste0(loop_name, " in ", contrast_name, ": ", nrow(df_filtered), " genes matched\n"))
    }
  }
}
cat("\n")

lfc_combined <- bind_rows(lfc_results) %>%
  mutate(category_label = paste0(loop_category, "\n(", contrast, ")"),
         type_contrast  = paste0(loop_type, "_", contrast))

cat(paste0("Total observations: ", nrow(lfc_combined), "\n\n"))

# Summary statistics
summary_stats <- lfc_combined %>%
  group_by(loop_category, loop_type, contrast) %>%
  summarise(n_genes = n(), median_abs_lfc = median(abs_lfc, na.rm = TRUE),
            mean_abs_lfc = mean(abs_lfc, na.rm = TRUE), sd_abs_lfc = sd(abs_lfc, na.rm = TRUE),
            n_sig = sum(padj < 0.05 & !is.na(padj)), .groups = "drop")

cat("=== SUMMARY STATISTICS ===\n")
print(summary_stats)
write.table(summary_stats, file.path(loops_dir, "loop_anchor_LFC_summary.tsv"),
            sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)

# Plot 1: Boxplot by category x contrast
p1 <- ggplot(lfc_combined, aes(x = loop_category, y = log2FoldChange, fill = loop_type)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.5, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  facet_wrap(~ contrast, ncol = 3, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("specific" = "#E41A1C", "shared" = "#377EB8")) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 9),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11), legend.position = "top") +
  labs(title = "Log2 Fold Change of Loop Anchor Genes",
       subtitle = "Comparison across specific and shared loop anchors",
       x = "Loop Anchor Category", y = "Log2 Fold Change", fill = "Loop Type")
print(p1)
ggsave(file.path(loops_dir, "loop_anchor_LFC_boxplot_by_category.pdf"), p1, width = 14, height = 8)

lfc_gene <- lfc_combined %>%
  group_by(gene, loop_type, contrast) %>%
  summarise(log2FoldChange = median(log2FoldChange, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

library(ggpubr)

# Plot 2: Violin specific vs shared (collapsed)
p_pub <- ggplot(lfc_gene, aes(loop_type, log2FoldChange, fill = loop_type)) +
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, outlier.shape = NA, color = "black") +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.1, alpha = 0.25, size = 0.8) +
  stat_compare_means(method = "wilcox.test", alternative = "greater", label = "p.signif") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("shared" = "#377EB8", "specific" = "#E41A1C")) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "none", axis.title = element_text(size = 13),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 11)) +
  labs(x = "Loop type", y = "Median log2 Fold Change per gene")
print(p_pub)
ggsave(file.path(loops_dir, "loop_anchor_LFC_violin_specific_vs_shared.pdf"), p_pub, width = 6, height = 6)

# Plot 3: Contrast-stratified
p_contrast <- ggplot(lfc_gene, aes(loop_type, log2FoldChange, fill = loop_type)) +
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, outlier.shape = NA) +
  facet_wrap(~ contrast, nrow = 1) +
  stat_compare_means(method = "wilcox.test", alternative = "greater") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("shared" = "#377EB8", "specific" = "#E41A1C")) +
  theme_bw()
print(p_contrast)
ggsave(file.path(loops_dir, "loop_anchor_LFC_violin_by_contrast.pdf"), p_contrast, width = 12, height = 6)

cat("\n=== LOOP ANCHOR ANALYSIS COMPLETE — plots saved to Loops/ ===\n")
cat(paste0("Output directory: ", loops_dir, "\n\n"))
```

```{r Compartment intersection}
data <- "R:/R_STIK/Hi-C/HiC_marta_Oct25/cscore/Comp_Analysis/files/cs_REH_merge.tab"

cs_REH_merge <- read.table(data,
                            sep       = "\t",
                            header    = TRUE,
                            stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

switching_levels <- c(
  "A_A_A", "B_B_B",
  "B_A_A", "B_B_A",
  "A_B_B", "A_A_B",
  "A_B_A", "B_A_B"
)

cs_REH_merge$switching <- factor(cs_REH_merge$switching, levels = switching_levels)

# ============================================================================
# INTERSECTION: Dynamic compartments × RNA-seq DEGs
# ============================================================================
library(GenomicRanges)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Build GRanges from compartment bins (dynamic only)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
dynamic_bins <- cs_REH_merge %>%
  filter(!switching %in% c("A_A_A", "B_B_B"))

bins_gr <- makeGRangesFromDataFrame(
  dynamic_bins %>% select(chr, start, end, switching),
  seqnames.field     = "chr",
  keep.extra.columns = TRUE
)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Load gene annotation
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
genes_bed <- read.table("R:/R_STIK/xavi_scripts/genes_gencode.v28.bed",
                        sep = "\t", header = FALSE,
                        col.names = c("chrom", "start", "end", "strand",
                                      "gene_name", "ID", "description")) %>%
  select(chrom, start, end, gene_name) %>%
  mutate(start = as.integer(start), end = as.integer(end))

genes_gr <- makeGRangesFromDataFrame(genes_bed,
                                     seqnames.field     = "chrom",
                                     keep.extra.columns = TRUE)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Overlap bins → genes
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
hits <- findOverlaps(bins_gr, genes_gr)

bin_gene_map <- data.frame(
  switching = bins_gr$switching[queryHits(hits)],
  gene_name = genes_gr$gene_name[subjectHits(hits)]
) %>% distinct()

cat("Unique genes overlapping dynamic bins:", n_distinct(bin_gene_map$gene_name), "\n")

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Pull RNA-seq results for all three contrasts
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
rnaseq_long <- bind_rows(
  all_results[["EP1_vs_REH"]] %>%
    select(gene, log2FoldChange, lfc_shrunk, padj, diffexpressed) %>%
    mutate(contrast = "EP1_vs_REH"),
  all_results[["Aro_vs_REH"]] %>%
    select(gene, log2FoldChange, lfc_shrunk, padj, diffexpressed) %>%
    mutate(contrast = "Aro_vs_REH"),
  all_results[["EP1_vs_Aro"]] %>%
    select(gene, log2FoldChange, lfc_shrunk, padj, diffexpressed) %>%
    mutate(contrast = "EP1_vs_Aro")
)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Join: bin_gene_map × RNA-seq results
#    switching stays as 3-letter code throughout
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
comp_rnaseq <- bin_gene_map %>%
  inner_join(rnaseq_long, by = c("gene_name" = "gene"))

cat("Genes with both compartment + RNA-seq data:", n_distinct(comp_rnaseq$gene_name), "\n")

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Concordance logic using 3-letter codes directly
#
#   REH | EP1 | Aro  (order of letters in the code)
#
#   A gains (B→A): B_A_A, B_A_B, B_B_A
#   B gains (A→B): A_B_B, A_B_A, A_A_B
#
#   EP1_vs_REH: REH→EP1 switch  → B_A_A, B_A_B (A gain), A_B_B, A_B_A (B gain)
#   Aro_vs_REH: REH→Aro switch  → B_B_A (A gain), A_A_B (B gain)
#   EP1_vs_Aro: EP1→Aro switch  → B_A_B (EP1=A, Aro=B → UP), A_B_A (EP1=B, Aro=A → DOWN)
#                                  B_B_A (Aro=A, EP1=B → DOWN), A_A_B (Aro=B, EP1=A → UP)
#                                  B_A_A / A_B_B → EP1=Aro → NOT informative
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
comp_rnaseq <- comp_rnaseq %>%
  mutate(
    concordant = case_when(

      # --- EP1_vs_REH ---
      switching %in% c("B_A_A", "B_A_B") &
        contrast == "EP1_vs_REH" & diffexpressed == "UP"   ~ "Concordant (A gain + UP)",
      switching %in% c("B_A_A", "B_A_B") &
        contrast == "EP1_vs_REH" & diffexpressed == "DOWN" ~ "Discordant (A gain + DOWN)",
      switching %in% c("A_B_B", "A_B_A") &
        contrast == "EP1_vs_REH" & diffexpressed == "DOWN" ~ "Concordant (B gain + DOWN)",
      switching %in% c("A_B_B", "A_B_A") &
        contrast == "EP1_vs_REH" & diffexpressed == "UP"   ~ "Discordant (B gain + UP)",

      # --- Aro_vs_REH ---
      switching == "B_B_A" &
        contrast == "Aro_vs_REH" & diffexpressed == "UP"   ~ "Concordant (A gain + UP)",
      switching == "B_B_A" &
        contrast == "Aro_vs_REH" & diffexpressed == "DOWN" ~ "Discordant (A gain + DOWN)",
      switching == "A_A_B" &
        contrast == "Aro_vs_REH" & diffexpressed == "DOWN" ~ "Concordant (B gain + DOWN)",
      switching == "A_A_B" &
        contrast == "Aro_vs_REH" & diffexpressed == "UP"   ~ "Discordant (B gain + UP)",

      # --- EP1_vs_Aro ---
      # B_A_B: EP1=A, Aro=B → EP1 more open → expect UP
      # A_A_B: EP1=A, Aro=B → same → expect UP
      switching %in% c("B_A_B", "A_A_B") &
        contrast == "EP1_vs_Aro" & diffexpressed == "UP"   ~ "Concordant (A gain + UP)",
      switching %in% c("B_A_B", "A_A_B") &
        contrast == "EP1_vs_Aro" & diffexpressed == "DOWN" ~ "Discordant (A gain + DOWN)",
      # A_B_A: EP1=B, Aro=A → EP1 more closed → expect DOWN
      # B_B_A: EP1=B, Aro=A → same → expect DOWN
      switching %in% c("A_B_A", "B_B_A") &
        contrast == "EP1_vs_Aro" & diffexpressed == "DOWN" ~ "Concordant (B gain + DOWN)",
      switching %in% c("A_B_A", "B_B_A") &
        contrast == "EP1_vs_Aro" & diffexpressed == "UP"   ~ "Discordant (B gain + UP)",

      TRUE ~ "Not DEG"
    )
  )

# Summary table
concordance_summary <- comp_rnaseq %>%
  dplyr::count(switching, contrast, concordant) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(switching, concordant)

print(concordance_summary)
write.table(concordance_summary,
            file.path(comp_dir, "concordance_summary.tsv"),
            sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Plot 1 — LFC distribution per switching class (3-letter codes), all contrasts
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Color palette for the 6 dynamic classes
switching_colors <- c(
  "B_A_A" = "#d95f02",
  "B_A_B" = "#fdae61",
  "B_B_A" = "#fee08b",
  "A_B_B" = "#542788",
  "A_B_A" = "#8073ac",
  "A_A_B" = "#b2abd2"
)

lfc_plot <- ggplot(comp_rnaseq,
       aes(x = switching, y = lfc_shrunk, fill = switching)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.4, outlier.alpha = 0.4, alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray30") +
  facet_wrap(~ contrast, nrow = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = switching_colors, na.value = "grey70") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x  = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 10),
        strip.text   = element_text(face = "bold"),
        plot.title   = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold")) +
  xlab("Compartment switching class (REH | EP1 | Aro)") +
  ylab("Shrunken Log2 Fold Change") +
  labs(title = "RNA-seq LFC in dynamic compartment bins",
       fill  = "Switching class")
print(lfc_plot)
ggsave(file.path(comp_dir, "LFC_distribution_switching_classes.pdf"),
       plot = lfc_plot, width = 12, height = 6)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Plot 2 — Concordance bar plot (3-letter codes on x-axis)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
concordance_colors <- c(
  "Concordant (A gain + UP)"   = "#f0a500",
  "Concordant (B gain + DOWN)" = "#6c3483",
  "Discordant (A gain + DOWN)" = "#f9d08b",
  "Discordant (B gain + UP)"   = "#c39bd3"
)

concordance_plot_df <- comp_rnaseq %>%
  dplyr::filter(concordant != "Not DEG") %>%
  dplyr::count(switching, contrast, concordant) %>%
  mutate(contrast = factor(contrast,
                           levels = c("EP1_vs_REH", "Aro_vs_REH", "EP1_vs_Aro")))

concordance_plot <- ggplot(concordance_plot_df,
       aes(x = switching, y = n, fill = concordant)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge",
           color = "black", linewidth = 0.35) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = concordance_colors) +
  facet_wrap(~ contrast, nrow = 1, scales = "free_x") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(plot.title  = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1)) +
  xlab("Switching class (REH | EP1 | Aro)") +
  ylab("Number of genes") +
  labs(title = "Compartment–transcription concordance (all contrasts)",
       fill  = "Category")
print(concordance_plot)
ggsave(file.path(comp_dir, "Transcription_concordance_switching_classes.pdf"),
       plot = concordance_plot, width = 14, height = 6)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 9. Volcano plot — colored by switching class (3-letter codes)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
library(ggrepel)

lfc_thresh  <- 1
padj_thresh <- 0.05

volcano_df <- comp_rnaseq %>%
  mutate(
    neglog10_padj = -log10(padj),
    contrast = factor(contrast, levels = c("EP1_vs_REH", "Aro_vs_REH", "EP1_vs_Aro")),
    point_class = case_when(
      padj < padj_thresh & abs(lfc_shrunk) > lfc_thresh ~ as.character(switching),
      TRUE                                               ~ "Not significant"
    )
  )

top_hits <- volcano_df %>%
  filter(padj < padj_thresh, abs(lfc_shrunk) > lfc_thresh) %>%
  group_by(contrast) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = neglog10_padj, n = 10) %>%
  ungroup()

point_colors <- c(switching_colors, "Not significant" = "grey75")
point_sizes  <- c(setNames(rep(2, 6), names(switching_colors)), "Not significant" = 1)
point_alpha  <- c(setNames(rep(0.9, 6), names(switching_colors)), "Not significant" = 0.4)

volcano_comp_plot <- ggplot(volcano_df,
       aes(x = lfc_shrunk, y = neglog10_padj,
           color = point_class, size = point_class, alpha = point_class)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-lfc_thresh, lfc_thresh),
             linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(padj_thresh),
             linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_text_repel(
    data          = top_hits,
    aes(x = lfc_shrunk, y = neglog10_padj, label = gene_name),
    size          = 3, color = "gray20", max.overlaps = 20,
    box.padding   = 0.4, segment.color = "gray50", segment.size = 0.3,
    min.segment.length = 0.2, inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ contrast, nrow = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = point_colors) +
  scale_size_manual(values  = point_sizes) +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = point_alpha) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey90"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.title       = element_text(hjust = 0, face = "bold", size = 13),
    strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95", color = "black"),
    legend.title     = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
    axis.title       = element_text(size = 11)
  ) +
  guides(size = "none", alpha = "none") +
  labs(
    title = "Volcano plot — genes in dynamic compartments",
    x     = "Shrunken log2 Fold Change",
    y     = "-log10 adjusted p-value",
    color = "Switching class\n(REH|EP1|Aro)"
  )
print(volcano_comp_plot)
ggsave(file.path(comp_dir, "Volcano_switching_classes.pdf"),
       plot = volcano_comp_plot, width = 12, height = 6)
```

```{r Compartment enrichment}
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Enrichment: switching class × contrast × direction (UP / DOWN)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

dbs <- c("GO_Biological_Process_2023",
         "KEGG_2021_Human",
         "WikiPathway_2023_Human",
         "Reactome_2022",
         "MSigDB_Hallmark_2020")

# Filter DEGs passing thresholds — keep direction (diffexpressed)
deg_filtered <- comp_rnaseq %>%
  filter(
    padj < 0.05,
    abs(log2FoldChange) > 1,
    diffexpressed %in% c("UP", "DOWN")
  ) %>%
  distinct(gene_name, switching, contrast, diffexpressed)

cat("DEGs per switching class, contrast, and direction:\n")
print(table(deg_filtered$switching, deg_filtered$contrast, deg_filtered$diffexpressed))

# Build gene lists: one per switching × contrast × direction
comp_gene_lists <- deg_filtered %>%
  group_by(switching, contrast, diffexpressed) %>%
  summarise(genes = list(unique(gene_name)), .groups = "drop")

cat("\nGene list sizes:\n")
print(data.frame(
  switching    = comp_gene_lists$switching,
  contrast     = comp_gene_lists$contrast,
  direction    = comp_gene_lists$diffexpressed,
  n_genes      = sapply(comp_gene_lists$genes, length)
))

comp_enrichr_results <- list()

for (i in seq_len(nrow(comp_gene_lists))) {

  sw_class  <- as.character(comp_gene_lists$switching[i])
  contrast  <- comp_gene_lists$contrast[i]
  direction <- comp_gene_lists$diffexpressed[i]
  gene_vec  <- comp_gene_lists$genes[[i]]
  list_key  <- paste0(sw_class, "_", contrast, "_", direction)

  cat("\n=== Switching:", sw_class,
      "| Contrast:", contrast,
      "| Direction:", direction,
      "| Genes:", length(gene_vec), "===\n")

  if (length(gene_vec) < 5 || !websiteLive) {
    cat("  Skipping – too few genes or enrichR offline\n")
    next
  }

  enriched <- enrichr(gene_vec, dbs)
  comp_enrichr_results[[list_key]] <- enriched

  for (db_idx in seq_along(dbs)) {
    db_name <- dbs[db_idx]

    if (is.null(enriched[[db_idx]]) || nrow(enriched[[db_idx]]) == 0) next

    enriched_processed <- process_enrichr_db(enriched[[db_idx]])
    sig_terms          <- subset(enriched_processed, Adjusted.P.value < 0.05)

    if (nrow(sig_terms) == 0) {
      cat("  No significant terms:", db_name, "\n")
      next
    }

    # Save TSV
    save_enrichr_genelists(
      sig_terms,
      prefix  = paste0(sw_class, "_", contrast, "_", direction, "_", db_name),
      out_dir = comp_enrichr_dir
    )

    # Plot
    p <- plot_enrichr(
      sig_terms,
      title_str = paste0(db_name, "\n", sw_class,
                         " | ", contrast, " | ", direction),
      xlab_str  = paste0(db_name, " Terms")
    )
    print(p)

    ggsave(
      filename = file.path(comp_enrichr_dir,
                           paste0("enrichR_", db_name, "_",
                                  sw_class, "_", contrast, "_", direction, ".pdf")),
      plot   = p,
      width  = 10,
      height = 7
    )

    cat("  Saved:", db_name, direction, "\n")
  }
}

cat("\n=== Compartment enrichR analysis complete ===\n")
```
